theater: 重慶合州釣魚城與涪江沿岸

battle.name: 紐粦攻四川之戰
battle.theater: 重慶合州釣魚城與涪江沿岸
battle.brief: 一二五七年秋，蒙古大汗蒙哥自雲南率主力東進，分道攻入南宋四川，前鋒沿涪江直抵合州釣魚城下，圍城逾年。卡面的希臘火不見於此役戰記，卻同屬以銅管陶罐裝載流體燃燒劑、專對付攻城器械與船隻的技術；真正定勝負的，是蒙古軍的配重投石機、雲梯與營寨，和宋軍據山城拒守、斷糧襲營的做法。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 一二五七年的四川戰場，是蒙古帝國與南宋在長江上游的正面碰撞。蒙古一方由大汗蒙哥總制，兵分多路自雲南出發：紐璹、汪德臣等率領汪古、哈剌兀良、乃蠻諸部眾，輔以漢地降軍與攻城工匠；大後方由烏瑞陽迦達坐鎮雲南，籌措糧秣與船隻，沿金沙江、雅礱江、大渡河分批轉運。馬隊居中，步卒配攻城營具隨行，糧草靠牛羊隨軍與河道水運交替供給。南宋一方以四川制置司為樞紐，節制成都府路、潼川府路、夔州路等沿江州府，並依余玠留下的山城防禦體系，倚釣魚城、大獲城、青居城、雲山城等要塞成梯次抵抗；沿江各城設水軍與遊奕往來，江防與山城互為犄角，專任知州與守將分別掌城防與城外山田、水利及糧源。蒙古軍求速決，南宋守軍求拖延，兩套指揮系統在重慶、合州一線正面對撞。
countriesEn: The Sichuan theatre of 1257 was the point where the Mongol empire and the Southern Song collided head-on in the upper Yangtze. On the Mongol side the campaign was commanded in person by the Great Khan Mongke, the main body moving east out of Yunnan in several columns: Newuu, Wang Dechen and other leaders brought up Urlung, Qarluq and Naiman contingents, supported by surrendered Chinese troops and siege craftsmen, while in the rear Uriyangqadai held Yunnan and saw to grain, cattle and river transport, moving supplies in batches along the Jinsha, Yalong and Dadu rivers. Horse columns formed the core, infantry and the siege train travelled with them, and food came either on the hoof with cattle and sheep or by water. On the Song side the command centre was the Sichuan Military Commission, which directed the prefectures of the Chengdu, Tongchuan and Kuizhou circuits along the river; the defence relied on the hill-fort system built under Yu Jie, with Diaoyu, Dahuo, Qingju and Yunshan fortresses forming a stepped screen, while river patrols and floating troops worked the crossings and the fortresses and the waterways supported one another. The Mongols wanted a quick decision, the Song wanted delay, and the two command systems met head-on around Chongqing and Hezhou.
people: 此役的核心人物分據兩端。蒙古方面：大汗蒙哥自雲南統軍，志在打通長江上游，與已在鄂州方向的忽必烈南北合擊；前鋒統帥汪德臣自幼隨軍，攻城陷陣屢建戰功，卻在一二五八年合州城下中宋軍飛石（一說中矢），創口不治而卒；蒙古貴族紐璹奉命自雲南領兵，為蒙哥開闢北上通道；曾任宋將的劉整降蒙後力主取道雲南，避開長江天險，其計策成為此次用兵的樞紐。本卡名稱所見的「紐粦」，在元代漢文編年與列傳中多作「紐璹」，一般認為同指蒙哥陣中這位主持雲南至四川正面進攻的蒙古主將。南方方面：釣魚城守將王堅入城後閉門不出，任蒙古軍填壕、架梯、攻城，屢次擊退衝鋒，後期以夜襲焚燒敵營寨，守城直至南宋覆亡；四川制置司一系的趙安等人分守廣元、沔州，節制秦蜀邊緣的援軍。蒙哥死後，阿里不哥在北方即位，忽必烈自鄂州回師爭位，前線將士分屬兩邊，戰局就此改寫。
peopleEn: The key figures of the campaign stand at the two ends of the line. For the Mongols: the Great Khan Mongke, who led the army out of Yunnan and aimed to open the upper Yangtze so as to close on the Song from the north and south with Kublai already operating around Ezhou; the vanguard commander Wang Dechen, who had campaigned since boyhood and repeatedly led assaults, but was struck at Hezhou by a stone thrown from a traction trebuchet (other accounts say an arrow), took a wound that would not close and died in the camp in early 1258; the Mongol noble Newuu, ordered to lead troops northward from Yunnan and to open the route for the main army; and Liu Zheng, a former Song general who had defected to the Mongols and pressed for a move through Dali and Yunnan so as to bypass the natural defences of the Yangtze, a plan that became the hinge of the whole operation. The name in the title of this card appears in Yuan Chinese annals usually as Newuu, and it is generally taken to be the Mongol commander who directed the frontal advance from Yunnan into Sichuan. On the Song side: Wang Jian, who took command at Diaoyu, refused to be drawn into a pitched battle, let the Mongols fill their ditches and raise their ladders, and repeatedly broke their assaults, later striking their camp by night and burning it, holding the fortress until the fall of the Song; commanders such as Zhao An held Guangyuan and Mianzhou and controlled the relief columns from the Qin-Sichuan border. When Mongke died, the Mongols at the front split between Arigh Qacha, who took the khanship in the north, and Kublai, who turned back from Ezhou, and the course of the war was rewritten.
kits: 卡面兵器是拜占庭帝國的希臘火：配在銅管裡的燃燒劑，配方是帝國的機密。它並未出現在一二五七年四川戰場的宋蒙戰記中，在這個位置上是同類技術的標誌物——把容易點燃的流體裝進管與罐，藉管口噴出或直接擲擲的燃燒器材。同期東方的寫法是「火油」與「猛火油」：宋人守城時以火油潑灑雲梯與攻具，蒙古軍則攜帶火球、火瓶與燃燒的箭矢，用以燒毀城頭的遮障、櫓樓與浮橋。一二五九年鄂州之戰，蒙古軍以火油焚毀宋人孟珙所建浮橋，是同一系列戰爭中最貼近本卡兵器用途的記載。真正在四川城下決定攻防的，還是配重投石機（回回炮）、雲梯、飛石、攻城木樓與壕溝填土：投石機既投射石彈，亦被改製用於投射燃燒物；宋軍的還擊手段是弓弩、床子弩、滾木與石塊，以及出奇兵焚燒敵營。糧秣方面，蒙古軍以牛羊隨軍、江河轉運相接，宋軍靠山城屯田與沿江漕運維持，攻城方需自雲南運糧千里，補給線成了最長的一條線。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is Greek fire, the burning liquid of the Byzantine Empire carried in bronze tubes, its formula a state secret. It did not appear in any Song or Mongol record of the fighting in Sichuan in 1257; here it stands for the same class of technology, a burning liquid stored in a pipe or a jar and delivered to the target through a nozzle or by being thrown. The eastern contemporary term was huoyou, fire oil or fierce fire oil: Song defenders splashed it on ladders and siege engines, while the Mongols carried fire balls, fire jars and burning arrows to burn the wooden sheds, the lookout towers and the floating bridges on the walls. In the siege of Ezhou in 1259 the Mongols used fire oil to burn the floating bridge built by the Song commander Meng Gong, the closest parallel to this card's weapon anywhere in the same series of wars. What really decided the fighting below Hezhou, however, was the counterweight trebuchet, ladders, stone throwers, siege towers and the filling of ditches; the trebuchet was used both to throw stones and, in modified form, burning projectiles, and the Song answered with bows and crossbows, rolling logs and stones on the narrow approach, and with sorties to burn the enemy camp. In the matter of supply, the Mongols depended on cattle and sheep on the hoof and on river transport, while the Song lived off the fields behind the hill-forts and the river convoys; the besiegers had to haul grain a thousand li from Yunnan, and the line of supply was the longest line in the campaign.
tactics: 蒙古軍的戰法是迂迴加強攻。一二五七年秋，出兵雲南，大軍不取長江正面，沿金沙江、大渡河、雅礱江的水陸兩路東行，分道進取，避開宋軍重兵把守的沿江平原地帶；抵川後分兵攻取沔州、廣元方向與涪江、瀘州、敘州一線，再合圍合州釣魚城。攻城序列有固定次序：先以配重投石機遠程壓制城頭與遮障，再填壕、搭木橋、架雲梯、立木樓逼近，最後由精兵突陣；軍中並在城外構築土城與營寨屯駐，以解決高原氣候與長久圍城的補給，同時派騎兵切斷合州與重慶之間的糧道與援軍，企圖以斷糧逼迫守軍出戰。宋軍的戰法是以逸待勞：據山城高險，閉門不戰，待蒙古軍填壕與夜戰疲憊時再以突兵焚其營寨、衝其器械，用弓弩與滾木在狹窄坡道上攔截攀城者；守軍同時派兵擾敵後方、護住田禾，並由重慶、瀘州方向的援軍企圖解合州之圍。圍城日久，蒙古軍內部因久攻不克與汗位繼承的分裂，終於在領袖陣亡後失去繼續攻城的意志。
tacticsEn: The Mongol method was encirclement combined with assault. In the autumn of 1257 the army left Yunnan without taking the Yangtze front, moving east by land and water along the Jinsha, Yalong and Dadu rivers, splitting into columns, and avoiding the open ground along the river where the Song had concentrated its best troops; on entering Sichuan they struck separately at the Mianzhou-Guangyuan direction and along the Fujiang, Luzhou and Xuzhou lines before closing on Hezhou and Diaoyu. The siege followed a fixed sequence: first the counterweight trebuchets were worked to suppress the wall-top and the shelters, then the ditches were filled, bridges built, ladders raised and timber towers pushed up to the wall, and only then did picked troops assault. Outside the walls the army built earthen towns and camp strongholds to solve the problems of thin highland air and long sieges, while cavalry detachments cut the grain road and the relief columns between Hezhou and Chongqing, hoping to starve the garrison into the open. The Song answered with a defence of attrition from fortified heights: the gates stayed shut, the Mongols were allowed to fill the ditches and exhaust themselves in night fighting, and only then were sorties launched to burn the camp and smash the engines, with bows, crossbows and rolling logs shooting down the men on the narrow slope. The defenders also sent troops to harry the Mongol rear and to guard the fields, while relief armies from Chongqing and Luzhou tried to break the ring. As the siege dragged on, the strain of the failed assaults and the quarrel over the succession told inside the Mongol camp, and once the leader was dead the will to continue the siege collapsed.
data: 兵力量級：元人修史常把蒙哥大軍寫成「號百萬」，這類數字屬修史者的概說，不宜當作實數；較穩妥的估計是數萬至數十萬人，其中中亞、蒙古本部與漢地降軍並列，攻城營具、備用馬匹與輜重所佔比例極高。時間跨度：一二五七年秋出兵雲南，同年冬入川，一二五八年春合州圍城起，至一二五九年八月蒙哥死於城下，全程不足兩年，單是釣魚城一座便被圍攻約十八個月；出兵的確切月份各書記載不一，有記作秋出師者，有記作冬出師者，本卡取九月。距離：自雲南大理到合州，陸路約一千二百公里，途中要跨越金沙江、雅礱江等高山峽谷，糧秣靠牛羊馱運與分段水運接駁，海拔落差直接制約攻城的時節。傷亡：蒙古軍攻城折損在漢文與波斯文史料中都沒有可用數字，可確認者僅為汪德臣與蒙哥兩名主將相繼陣亡，攻城器械的損失亦無統計；南宋方面，釣魚城守軍在十八個月中屢出突擊成功，自身消耗同樣缺乏記載。器械：配重投石機常被描述為可拋射數十至百餘步，攻城雲梯高與城齊，火油以甕罐盛裝隨軍攜帶，總量不見於文獻。本卡可確定的只有量級與時序，不作精確人數與傷亡推算。
dataEn: On the numbers: Song and Yuan historians habitually describe Mongke's host as numbering a hundred thousand, and such figures are rhetorical summary rather than record; a safer estimate is tens of thousands, drawn from Central Asia, the Mongol homeland and surrendered Chinese troops, with the siege train, remounts and baggage taking a very large share. On time: the army left Yunnan in the autumn of 1257, entered Sichuan that winter, the siege of Hezhou began in the spring of 1258, and Mongke died beneath the walls in the eighth month of 1259, so the campaign as a whole lasted under two years, while Diaoyu alone was invested for roughly eighteen months; the precise month of departure is recorded inconsistently, some texts saying autumn and others winter, and this card takes September. On distance: from Dali to Hezhou is about twelve hundred kilometres overland, crossing the Jinsha and the Yalong through high gorges; grain travelled by pack animals and in stages by water, and the drop in altitude dictated the season of the campaign. On losses: no usable figures survive in the Chinese or Persian accounts for the Mongol dead, the certain points being the deaths of two leading commanders, Wang Dechen and Mongke, and the loss of siege engines, for which there is likewise no tally; on the Song side the Diaoyu garrison scored repeated success with sorties over eighteen months, but its own losses are equally unrecorded. On equipment: traction trebuchets are described as throwing to distances of several tens to a hundred paces, siege ladders were built to the height of the wall, and the fire oil was carried in jars and pots with the army, with no totals preserved. Only the order of magnitude and the sequence can be stated here, and no precise casualty figure is invented.
cause: 起戰的根由有三層。第一層是蒙古帝國的國策：一二五一年忽必烈受命經營汗國之後，滅宋被定為基本方略；然而宋沿長江與襄樊一線的城防堅固，蒙古正面強攻屢見成效甚微。第二層是戰略選擇：宋將劉整降蒙後指出，長江兩岸與荊襄地勢利於守方，蒙古軍改取雲南大理故道，從高原東下，攻宋的側背與大後方，此策在元人記述中被列為此次用兵的關鍵。第三層是南宋自身的處境：四川是國庫與兵源所在，卻久缺糧秣，制置司更替頻繁，余玠開創的山城防禦體系雖有效，卻因官員爭權與糧道不足而難以主動出擊。蒙哥即位後亟需一場勝利以鞏固大汗權威，遂在統一調動雲南、漢地與中亞兵力之後，於一二五七年自雲南發兵，把兵鋒指向重慶、合州一線的四川山城，打算先拔除長江上游的屏障，再與鄂州的忽必烈會合，形成南北兩面的夾擊。
causeEn: There were three layers behind the outbreak of war. The first was Mongol state policy: after taking charge of the khanate in 1251, Kublai had made the destruction of the Song a standing objective, but the Song defences along the Yangtze and around Xiangyang proved too strong for frontal assault, and Mongol attacks from the north had achieved little. The second was a choice of strategy: Liu Zheng, having defected, pointed out that the terrain of the river banks and of Jingxiang favoured the defender, so the Mongols took the old road through Dali and Yunnan and came down from the plateau to strike the Song from the side and from the rear; in Yuan accounts this is credited as the key of the campaign. The third was the Song's own position: Sichuan was the treasury and the source of troops, yet it was chronically short of grain, the military commission was replaced repeatedly, and the hill-fort system Yu Jie had created worked well but could not be turned into an active offensive because of quarrels between officials and thin supply lines. Mongke, newly enthroned, needed a victory to secure his authority over the khanate, so after concentrating forces from Yunnan, China and Central Asia he set out from Yunnan in 1257 and drove them at the fortified hills around Chongqing and Hezhou, intending to remove the shield of the upper Yangtze first and then to join Kublai at Ezhou in a two-pronged pincer.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果，超出了四川一省。第一，蒙哥死於釣魚城下，忽必烈自鄂州回師北上與阿里不哥爭位，蒙古帝國在亞洲腹地陷入為時數年的內部分裂，南下攻宋的節奏被迫放慢，宋朝因此多出數年喘息之機；其後各路蒙古軍重組，進攻重心再度轉向襄樊與鄂州，攻城技術也由急攻轉為長期圍困與配重砲的系統化使用。第二，南宋四川的山城防禦體系經此役一戰成名，釣魚城、大獲城、青居城等要塞被後世視為抗元骨幹，成為重慶一帶的地標；馬可波羅後來的記述更把釣魚城的堅固傳到西方，十九世紀以來，它常被列入世界軍事工程奇蹟一類的名單。第三，蒙古人在漢地大量徵用工匠與俘獲的攻城技術，把回回炮、樓車、火攻等手段制度化，同時把雲南至四川的山道與水運納入長期控制的交通網，為其後接管全川與打通長江航運鋪了路。第四，這場圍城成為冷兵器時代攻城戰的教科書案例：以逸待勞、斷糧、夜襲、飛石破城與守軍的反覆出擊，在十八個月的時間裡互相咬合，最終改變了兩個政權的命運。
impactEn: The consequences of this campaign reached far beyond the borders of Sichuan. First, Mongke died under the walls of Diaoyu, Kublai turned back from Ezhou to contest the khanship with Arigh Qacha, and the Mongol empire in the heart of Asia was thrown into several years of internal division; the pace of the southern campaign slowed, the Song gained a breathing space of some years, the Mongol forces were reorganised, the centre of gravity moved back to Xiangyang and Ezhou, and siege warfare shifted from rush assaults to systematic blockade backed by traction artillery. Second, the Song hill-fort system in Sichuan became famous through this campaign; Diaoyu, Dahuo, Qingju and the other fortresses were treated in later ages as the backbone of resistance to the Mongols and remain landmarks around Chongqing, and the account of Marco Polo carried their strength to the West, so that since the nineteenth century Diaoyu has often been listed among the wonders of military engineering. Third, the Mongols recruited craftsmen and captured siege technique on a large scale within China, institutionalising traction artillery, siege towers and fire attack, while the roads and water routes from Yunnan into Sichuan were folded into a transport network under lasting control, opening the way for the eventual takeover of the whole province and for the opening of Yangtze navigation. Fourth, the siege became a textbook case of siegecraft in the age of cold weapons: waiting for the enemy to tire, cutting his supply, night sorties, stone throwers against the wall and the garrison's repeated counter-strikes all locked together over eighteen months, and in the end changed the fortunes of two states.
result: 就一二五七年的攻勢而言，蒙古軍的結果是失敗：合州釣魚城沒有被攻下，圍城在持續約十八個月後因蒙哥在城下病亡而中止，蒙古大軍北返爭位，留在川東的部隊則在餘波中被宋軍收復部分城池，攻勢整體後退。南宋方面的結果是守住一座要塞而付出整個四川淪陷的代價：釣魚城守軍一直抵抗到南宋覆亡前夕，前後守城數十年，被視為宋代最頑強的抗元堡壘；同時蒙哥之死引發的汗位爭奪，使蒙古的滅宋戰爭第一次出現重大挫折，也讓南宋得以在襄樊仍被圍困的年份裡喘上一口氣。從更長的尺度看，此役並未改變元滅宋的結局：重慶等沿江重鎮在十餘年後相繼陷落，宋室於一二七九年覆亡；釣魚城的抵抗被史家視為延緩而非阻止蒙古征服的關鍵一環，而那件配在銅管裡的燃燒劑所代表的技術，在這場戰爭裡沒有留下任何可考的使用痕跡，它真正的作用，是提醒後人攻城與守城的勝負常常落在砲石、糧道與士氣，而不是任何一件奇兵。
resultEn: For the offensive of 1257 the result on the Mongol side was failure. Diaoyu was not taken; the siege ended about eighteen months later when Mongke died of illness beneath the walls, the main army withdrew northward to fight over the succession, and the columns left in eastern Sichuan lost ground to the Song again, so the offensive as a whole went backwards. On the Song side the result was that one fortress was saved at the price of the whole province: the Diaoyu garrison held out until the eve of the Song's extinction, resisting for several decades, and is remembered as the most tenacious anti-Mongol redoubt of the Song. At the same time the death of Mongke and the ensuing dispute over the khanship produced the first major setback of the Mongol war against the Song and gave the Song a moment of relief in the very years when Xiangyang was still besieged. In the longer run the campaign did not change the outcome of the Yuan conquest: Chongqing and the other river strongholds fell in turn in the 1270s, and the Song house perished in 1279. Historians generally read the resistance of Diaoyu as something that delayed rather than prevented the Mongol conquest, and the burning liquid carried in the bronze tube on this card left no traceable use in the fighting of this war; its real function is to remind us that sieges are usually decided by stone, supply and morale rather than by any single wonder-weapon.
